texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the FileClerk module
texts.FileClerk:FileClerkEnabledDescription: Enables File Clerk for the current host or tenant.
texts.FileClerk:FileClerkProvidersDescription: Select the BLOB providers that File Clerk may use.
texts.FileClerk:InvalidImplementationType: The provider implementation type is not a valid C# full type name.
texts.FileClerk:InvalidConfigurationSchema: The provider configuration schema must be valid JSON containing a connectionString property.
texts.FileClerk:ProviderNotFound: The selected BLOB provider registration does not exist.
texts.FileClerk:ProviderDisabled: The selected BLOB provider is globally disabled.
texts.FileClerk:ProviderNotSelected: The selected BLOB provider is not enabled for the current host or tenant.
texts.FileClerk:DuplicateProviderSelection: A BLOB provider may be selected only once.
texts.FileClerk:ProviderSelectionOutOfScope: The selected BLOB provider is not available to the current tenant.
texts.FileClerk:HostFileClerkDisabled: File Clerk is disabled by the host.
texts.FileClerk:HostOnlyOperation: Only a host administrator can perform this operation.
